forms.form:
te zullen overhoopschieten
overhoop te zullen schieten

glosses: op onbezonnen wijze iemand met een schietwapen ernstig verwonden of doden

examples.text: Voordat de politie ter plaatse was, hadden zij elkaar al overhoopgeschoten.
Die Angreifer schossen wahllos in die Menge und sogar Einzelne, die weglaufen wollten, wurden von hinten niedergeknallt.

glosses: To cause to fall by shooting.

examples.text: The carnival game involved shooting down tin cans.
My grandfather shot down several fighter planes in the war.
Stop using your words as weapons / They're never gonna shoot me down / Stop, it's time that you learned a lesson / My love is gonna drown you out
In China, authorities said they might soon shoot down an unidentified flying object over waters near the northern city of Rizhao, The South China Morning Post reported.

glosses: To criticize (a request) to the point of preclusion.

examples.text: Every proposal I made was shot down at once.
